title: Verify by Doing: Co-Evolving Agent Execution and Evaluation without External Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2611.15276v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent self-improvement requires feedback about task success, yet external feedback may be unavailable at test time. Agents must then infer success from observable evidence, and incomplete verification can misguide subsequent updates. We introduce Verify by Doing (VbD), a method that co-evolves Actor and Evaluator harnesses within a single task while keeping model weights fixed. The Evaluator actively inspects artifacts and environment state with tools; its findings ground an internal signal for output selection and guide updates to both execution and verification procedures. Proposed Evaluators undergo comparative review on common candidates, while Actor updates require support from their own fresh outputs. translated_title: 通过实践验证：无需外部反馈的智能体执行与评估协同进化
translated_abstract: 智能体的自我改进需要关于任务成功的反馈，但在测试时外部反馈可能不可用。此时智能体必须从可观察的证据中推断任务是否成功，而不完整的验证可能会误导后续的更新。我们提出了 Verify by Doing（VbD），一种在单一任务内使执行者（Actor）与评估者（Evaluator）框架协同进化的方法，同时保持模型权重固定不变。评估者使用工具主动检查产出物和环境状态；其发现为输出选择奠定内部信号的基础，并指导执行流程和验证流程的更新。提出的评估者会在共同候选上进行对比审查，而执行者的更新则需要其自身新鲜产出的支持。在 AutomationBench、τ³ Banking 以及精选的 GDPval 任务上，VbD 在不使用外部反馈的对比方法中取得了最高的总体分数，相比其他方法分别提升了 3.3、4.1 和 2.3 个百分点。
tldr: 提出了 Verify by Doing（VbD）方法，在模型权重固定且无外部反馈的条件下，通过执行者与评估者在单一任务内协同进化，利用工具主动检查产出与环境状态来生成内部信号，同时指导执行与验证流程的更新，在多个基准测试上取得最优成绩。
en_tdlr: Verify by Doing (VbD) co-evolves Actor and Evaluator harnesses within a single task without external feedback or weight updates, using tool-based inspection of artifacts and environment state to generate internal signals that guide updates to both execution and verification procedures.
